review: Root directly viewed all five source forms: broad eight-legged spider with pale fangs, heavy green ape with long arms, closed brass-banded chest, tooth-lined awakened chest and low four-limbed glowmaw. Distinct stepped silhouettes use the dark green/ochre/cream palette. This is source art review only; native importer, rig ownership, state transitions and actual in-game composition remain separate acceptance gates.
